title: Bus number 522 breaks down in Sunnyvale, near MollyTea.
content: A bus bearing bus number 522 which was going from Palo alto in El Camino Real towards San Jose, suddenly faced a technical failure for which the lane got blocked and traffic didnot move. It was on the road blocking other vehicles till the Fire & Towing vehicle came. Which was really frustrating to everyone on road. Aftre the emergency vehicle cleared the road after nearly 2 hours the traffic got cleared around 6p.m in the evening.
